verdict.rationale: Apple documents official developer frameworks that target Apple silicon such as the M4 Max: Metal 4 with ML integration and a debugger, MLX from Apple machine learning research, and PyTorch backends for on-Mac training. The evidence is mostly marketing-level snippets, though, and gives little on SDK depth, APIs or AI-agent-friendly docs (the llms.txt probe returned 404). missing for 10: detailed SDK/API reference and language-binding documentation, AI-native developer docs (llms.txt 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, brought to you by Apple machine learning research.
Metal 4 enables entirely new ways to integrate machine learning while also enabling you to encode commands and compile shaders more efficiently than ever.
Accelerate the training of machine learning models in third-party frameworks right on your Mac with PyTorch backends.
Inspect, debug, and optimize your entire rendering pipeline with Metal debugger
